channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: SWCorp goes undercover to catch litterbugs, 102 notices issued in Pahang
item.description: TEMERLOH:Think twice before littering on the streets, as the Solid Waste and Public Cleansing Management Corporation (SWCorp) has deployed undercover officers to catch offenders in the act.

item.title: No immediate need to suspend Azam Baki, says Anwar
item.description: SHAH ALAM: There is no immediate need to suspend Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) chief commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki from his duties while a special committee investigates allegations reported by Bloomberg.

item.title: Ee Wei ready to accept fast and furious 15-point scoring
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Mixed doubles world champion Toh Ee Wei feels that the 15-point scoring system will be faster, but she has vowed to be ready for the new challenge with Chen Tang Jie if it is introduced next year by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Kim Kardashian feels 'safe' with Lewis Hamilton
item.description: LOS ANGELES: The world of celebrity romance has a new frontrunner as Kim Kardashian reportedly finds a sense of security and "safety" in her budding relationship with Formula One icon Lewis Hamilton.

item.title: Wawasan Dengkil bags RM25mil data centre works
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Wawasan Dengkil Holdings Bhd’s subsidiary, Wawasan Dengkil Sdn Bhd, has secured a RM24.8 million contract from Gamuda Bhd’s unit, Gamuda Engineering Sdn Bhd, for a data centre project in Selangor.

item.title: Is that so?': Azam Baki denies MACC raid on Rafizi Ramli
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: "Is that so?" (Ye ke?) This was Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) chief commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki's response to claims that Pandan Member of Parliament Datuk Seri Rafizi Ramli was bracing for a raid by the anti-graft agency.

item.title: ISF Group unit bags RM10mil plumbing contract from Kerjaya Prospek
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: ISF Group Bhd’s unit, Yeo Plumber Sdn Bhd, has bagged a RM10 million contract from Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn Bhd for cold-water and sanitary plumbing works for a serviced apartment project with commercial lots.

item.title: MCMC investigating suspected fake accounts linked to Dewan Rakyat livestreams
Ukraine expects final IMF deal approval in coming weeks
item.description: LONDON: Ukraine expects its new US$8.2 billion programme with the International Monetary Fund to be formally approved in weeks, its debt chief has told Reuters, a telegraphed but symbolic step, with the war with Russia about to grind into a fifth year.

item.title: Graft watchdog calls for independent probe over Bloomberg allegations
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Transparency International Malaysia (TI-M) has called for an independent, time-bound investigation following allegations made in a Bloomberg report linked to the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC).
